changelog.title: What's New
changelog.subtitle: Recent improvements and fixes in TaybGo Seller.
changelog.menuSubtitle: See what changed in the latest TaybGo Seller versions.

v1018.change1: Added a full-screen incoming-order experience with smooth animations, compact order essentials, accept/reject actions, and support for multiple new orders.
v1018.change2: Added immediate, preset, and custom driver-request delays with a live countdown until dispatch.
v1018.change3: Added menu-item deletion with confirmation, clear warnings, and translated success and error feedback.
v1018.change4: Improved menu-item creation and editing with safer validation and clearer warnings when an item cannot be changed.
v1018.change5: Improved order polling and incoming-order presentation so updates are less disruptive and easier to follow.
v1018.change6: Added item-only editing for incoming orders before acceptance, allowing sellers to add, remove, or replace items while keeping customer, address, payment, delivery fee, and pricing controls protected by the server.
v1018.change7: Added Reject Order to new orders with confirmation and clear action feedback.
v1018.change8: Added All and Rejected filters in Done orders so rejected orders are easy to find.
v1018.change9: Improved seller order editing and made action availability follow the order status.
v1018.change10: Seller order cards and details now show the server-calculated seller total without delivery fees or tips.
v1018.change11: Added Notification Settings with configurable order-alert repetition: 1, 3, 5, or 7 times; 7 is selected by default.
v1018.change12: Made email required when creating a seller account and read-only in Edit Profile.
v1018.change13: Enabled support-ticket notifications with push and in-app alerts, direct ticket navigation, read-state updates, refresh on app resume, 5-second notification polling, and 3-second support-chat polling.

v1016.change1: Fixed order notification taps so order details open smoothly without a temporary ‘Order not found’ message.
v1016.change2: Improved direct order loading and notification payload handling for foreground, background, and terminated app states.
v1016.change3: Added regression coverage for notification-opened order details and built dev and prod split APKs locally for all supported Android ABIs.

v1015.change1: Restored address autocomplete and coordinate lookup in Flutter Web through the Google Maps JavaScript Places library.
v1015.change2: Added a compatibility fallback for Google projects that still use the established Places JavaScript service.
v1015.change3: Centralized Google Maps configuration while preserving the existing native Places REST behavior for Android and iOS.
v1015.change4: Published signed dev and prod split APKs for ARM 64-bit, ARM 32-bit, and x86 64-bit devices.

v1014.change1: Added flexible seller sign-in that follows the latest account policy automatically.
v1014.change2: Added secure password sign-in while keeping verification-code sign-in available when enabled.
v1014.change3: Added a required-update screen so unsupported app versions can be upgraded safely.
v1014.change4: Terms and Privacy links now stay synchronized with TaybGo services.
v1014.change5: Improved sign-in validation and error messages while preserving short and international phone-number support.
v1014.change6: Added safer fallback behavior when online app settings are temporarily unavailable.

v1013.change1: Added a new What's New page under Help & Support.
v1013.change2: Renamed Pending Orders to New Orders and included pending, accepted, and driver-search orders.
v1013.change3: Added a compact status filter to quickly find different types of new orders.
v1013.change4: Improved seller login for short, formatted, and pasted international phone numbers.
v1013.change5: Fixed an issue that could prevent the order total from updating during order creation.
v1013.change6: Limited delivery vehicle choices to currently supported options.
v1013.change7: The guided tour now disappears automatically once your restaurant has orders.
v1013.change8: Added translations for all new screens and improvements.

v1012.change1: Improved seller login with country-aware formatting and support for short or test numbers.
v1012.change2: Added pasted international number support with automatic country detection for + and 00 prefixes.
v1012.change3: Added support for formatted phone numbers and Arabic and Persian digits.

v1011.change1: Standardized seller-facing prices and totals on the euro symbol.
v1011.change2: Updated currency display across orders, earnings, menus, help content, and PDF receipts.
v1011.change3: Aligned the web app configuration and hosting for a more consistent release.

v1010.change1: Refreshed food-order pricing when customer phone or country details change.
v1010.change2: Added vehicle type to food-order pricing, creation, and update flows.
v1010.change3: Improved the accuracy of pricing previews before an order is submitted.

v109.change1: Redesigned the seller profile with a compact restaurant header and grouped settings.
v109.change2: Added delivery availability controls and kept restaurant state synchronized.
v109.change3: Updated order actions to follow the statuses allowed by the server.

gsWelcome.title: Welcome to TaybGo Seller
gsWelcome.description: An overview of the app and what you can do with it.
gsWelcome.s1Body: TaybGo Seller is your all-in-one restaurant management app. It lets you receive and manage orders, update your menu in real time, create promotional coupons, and track your business performance — all from your phone.
gsWelcome.s2Body:
• Real-time order management with status tracking
• Full menu editing with categories, images, and customizations
• Coupon creation and discount management
• Business analytics and revenue tracking
• AI-powered order scanning for manual orders
• Push notifications for new orders
• Dark mode and theme customization
• Multi-language support (English, Arabic, German, French)
gsWelcome.s3Body: You can access this Knowledge Base anytime from Profile > Knowledge Base. For hands-on guidance, tap the "Start Interactive Tour" button at the top of this page to walk through the app step by step.

gsNav.title: Navigating the App
gsNav.description: Learn about the main screens and how to move between them.
gsNav.s1Body:
The app has four main tabs at the bottom of the screen:

• Home — Your dashboard showing today's stats and pending orders
• Orders — Manage all incoming, active, and completed orders
• Menu — View and edit your restaurant's menu items
• Profile — Access settings, statistics, coupons, and more
gsNav.s2Body: The Home screen gives you a quick overview of your day. You'll see your pending order count, today's revenue, and total orders. Tap "See all" to jump to the full orders list, or use the quick action buttons to create an order or start the app tour.
gsNav.s3Body: When you open a detail screen (like order details or menu item editing), use the back arrow at the top-left to return to the previous screen. The bottom navigation bar is always visible on the main tabs.

ordersManaging.title: Viewing & Managing Orders
ordersManaging.description: How to view, search, and track your orders.
ordersManaging.s1Body:
The Orders screen has three tabs:

• New — Orders waiting for your response (accept or reject)
• Active — Orders you've accepted that are being prepared or delivered
• Done — Completed, delivered, rejected, or cancelled orders
ordersManaging.s2Body: Use the search bar at the top of the Orders screen to find specific orders. You can search by order ID, customer name, phone number, or item names. Search works across all three tabs simultaneously.
ordersManaging.s3Body: Orders automatically refresh every 5 seconds to keep you up to date. You can also pull down to manually refresh the list at any time. The app pauses automatic refresh when running in the background to save battery.
ordersManaging.s4Body:
Tap any order card to open its full details. You'll see:

• Customer name, phone, and delivery address
• All ordered items with quantities and customizations
• Payment status and order totals
• A visual timeline showing the order's status progression
• Action buttons to update the order status

ordersStatus.title: Accepting & Updating Order Status
ordersStatus.description: How to accept, reject, and move orders through each stage.
ordersStatus.s1Body:
When a new order arrives, you have two options:

• Accept — The order moves to your Active tab and the system searches for a delivery driver
• Reject — The order is declined (this cannot be undone)

You'll receive a push notification whenever a new order comes in.
ordersStatus.s2Body:
After accepting, an order progresses through these stages:

1. Accepted — You're preparing the order
2. Searching for Driver — The system is finding a driver
3. Driver Notified — A driver has been assigned
4. Ready for Delivery — Food is ready for pickup
5. On the Way — Driver is delivering to customer
6. Delivered / Completed — Order is done

Use the status buttons on the order detail screen to advance through stages.
ordersStatus.s3Body: If you accidentally update an order's status, you'll see a brief "Undo" option appear as a snackbar at the bottom of the screen. Tap it quickly to revert the change.

ordersCreate.title: Creating Manual Orders
ordersCreate.description: How to create orders manually for phone or walk-in customers.
ordersCreate.s1Body: Use the Create Order feature when a customer places an order by phone, in person, or through a channel outside the app. This lets you log the order in the system for tracking and delivery.
ordersCreate.s2Body:
From the Orders screen or Home, tap "Create Order". Fill in:

1. Customer name and phone number
2. Delivery address (use the address search for autocomplete)
3. Add items from your menu
4. Optionally add a coupon, delivery fee, or tips
5. Set payment status and any order notes
6. Tap Submit to create the order
ordersCreate.s3Body: When entering a delivery address, the app uses Google Places autocomplete. Start typing at least 3 characters and suggestions will appear. Select a suggestion to auto-fill the full address with coordinates.

ordersScan.title: AI Order Scanning
ordersScan.description: Use AI to scan paper orders and extract details automatically.
ordersScan.s1Body: The AI Scan feature uses Gemini AI to read order forms from photos. Take a picture of a handwritten or printed order, and the AI will extract customer details, items, quantities, and addresses automatically.
ordersScan.s2Body:
• Place the order form on a flat surface
• Ensure good lighting without shadows
• Keep the text in focus and readable
• For multi-page orders, take multiple photos
• You can use the camera or pick images from your gallery
ordersScan.s3Body: After scanning, you'll see a verification screen showing all extracted data. Fields with low confidence are highlighted so you can review them. Correct any mistakes, fill in missing fields, then submit the order.

menuItems.title: Managing Menu Items
menuItems.description: Add, edit, and organize your restaurant's menu.
menuItems.s1Body: The Menu screen shows all your items organized by category. Use the horizontal category tabs at the top to filter by category, or use the search bar to find specific items by name, description, or ingredients.
menuItems.s2Body:
Tap the "+" button on the Menu screen to add a new item. Fill in:

• Item name and description
• Price
• Category (select from existing or create new)
• Ingredients list
• Item image (from camera or gallery)
• Preparation time
• Availability status
menuItems.s3Body: Tap any menu item card to open its detail view, then tap "Edit Item" to modify its details. Changes are saved when you tap "Save".
menuItems.s4Body: Swipe a menu item card to quickly toggle its availability. When an item is marked unavailable, it's hidden from customers. This is useful when you run out of an ingredient temporarily.
menuItems.s5Body: Swipe a menu item to reveal the delete option. You'll be asked to confirm before the item is permanently removed.

menuCats.title: Menu Categories
menuCats.description: Organize your menu with categories for better structure.
menuCats.s1Body: Categories help organize your menu into logical sections like "Burgers", "Pizza", "Drinks", "Desserts", etc. Customers see these categories when browsing your public menu.
menuCats.s2Body:
Go to Menu > Categories (via the categories icon) to:

• Add new categories with a name
• Edit existing category names
• Delete categories (items in the category will also be affected)

Each category shows how many items it contains.
menuCats.s3Body: On the main Menu screen, the horizontal category tabs let you quickly filter your view. Tap "All" to see everything, or tap a specific category to show only items in that group.

menuCustom.title: Item Customizations & Extras
menuCustom.description: Set up extras and removal options for menu items.
menuCustom.s1Body:
Customizations let customers modify their order items. There are two types:

• Extras (Additions) — Options that add ingredients with an additional cost (e.g., "Extra Cheese +€1.50")
• Removals — Ingredients customers can request to remove (e.g., "No Onions", "No Pickles")
menuCustom.s2Body: When editing a menu item, scroll to the Customizations section and tap "Add Extra". Enter the extra's name and additional price. You can add as many extras as needed.
menuCustom.s3Body: In the same Customizations section, tap "Add Removal Option" to let customers request ingredient removals. These have no price change — they're simply instructions for the kitchen.

couponsCreate.title: Creating Coupons
couponsCreate.description: Set up promotional discount codes for your customers.
couponsCreate.s1Body:
Go to Profile > Coupons and tap the "+" button. Fill in:

• Coupon title and description
• Unique coupon code (or tap "Generate" for a random code)
• Discount percentage
• Minimum order price requirement
• Maximum usage limits
• Start and end dates
couponsCreate.s2Body: When a coupon is applied to an order, the discount percentage is calculated on the order subtotal. The coupon will only work if the order meets the minimum price requirement you set.
couponsCreate.s3Body: When creating a manual order, you can select an active coupon to apply. The discount will be automatically calculated and shown in the order summary.

couponsManage.title: Managing Coupons
couponsManage.description: Edit, activate, deactivate, and track your coupons.
couponsManage.s1Body:
The Coupons screen shows all your coupons with filter tabs:

• All — Every coupon
• Active — Currently usable coupons
• Expired — Past their end date

Each coupon card shows its code, discount, and current status.
couponsManage.s2Body: Tap a coupon to edit its details. You can update any field except the code. To delete a coupon, use the delete option on the coupon card. Deleted coupons cannot be recovered.
couponsManage.s3Body: You can quickly activate or deactivate a coupon without deleting it. Deactivated coupons won't work for customers but remain in your list so you can re-enable them later.

settingsTheme.title: Theme & Appearance
settingsTheme.description: Customize dark mode and accent colors.
settingsTheme.s1Body: Toggle dark mode from Profile using the dark mode switch. Dark mode reduces eye strain in low-light environments and can save battery on OLED screens.
settingsTheme.s2Body:
Tap "Accent Color" in Profile to choose from 8 color options:

Green, Blue, Purple, Orange, Red, Teal, Pink, and Indigo.

The accent color is used for buttons, highlights, active navigation items, and other interactive elements throughout the app.

settingsLang.title: Language Settings
settingsLang.s1Body: The app supports multiple languages including English, Arabic, German, and French. You can also select your language on the login screen.
settingsLang.s2Body: Go to Profile > Language and select your preferred language. The app will immediately switch all text to the selected language. Your language preference is saved and persists across app restarts.

settingsNotif.title: Notification Preferences
settingsNotif.s1Body:
You can configure notifications for:

• New Orders — Get alerted when a new order arrives
• Order Updates — Status changes on your orders
• Promotions — News and special offers from TaybGo
settingsNotif.s2Body:
In the notification settings, you can also control:

• Sound — Enable or disable notification sounds
• Vibration — Enable or disable haptic feedback

These settings are independent of your device's system notification settings.
settingsNotif.s3Body: Tap the bell icon on the Home screen to see your notification history. Unread notifications show a count badge. Use "Mark all read" to clear the unread count.

statsOverview.title: Understanding Your Analytics
statsOverview.description: Track revenue, orders, and performance metrics.
statsOverview.s1Body:
You can view your analytics in two ways:

• Quick stats on the Profile screen (today's revenue and order count)
• Detailed view via Profile > "View Stats" button
statsOverview.s2Body:
The Statistics screen lets you view data for different time periods:

• Today — Current day's performance
• Week — Last 7 days
• Month — Last 30 days
• Year — Last 12 months
statsOverview.s3Body:
• Total Orders — Number of orders in the selected period
• Revenue — Total income from all orders
• Average Order — Mean order value
• Customers — Unique customers served
• Top Selling Items — Your most popular menu items

tipsGestures.title: Swipe Actions & Gestures
tipsGestures.description: Speed up your workflow with swipe gestures.
tipsGestures.s1Body:
On the Orders screen, swipe order cards to quickly:

• Accept pending orders
• Update order status to the next stage
• This saves time compared to opening each order individually
tipsGestures.s2Body:
On the Menu screen, swipe item cards to:

• Toggle availability (mark available/unavailable)
• Delete items

Swipe actions show colored indicators so you know what action will be taken.
tipsGestures.s3Body: Pull down on any list screen (Orders, Menu, Notifications) to manually refresh the data. This is useful if you want to check for updates immediately instead of waiting for the auto-refresh.

tipsBest.title: Best Practices
tipsBest.description: Tips to get the most out of the app.
tipsBest.s1Body:
• Mark items as unavailable as soon as you run out
• Update prices regularly to reflect current costs
• Add clear descriptions and images to attract customers
• Use categories to keep your menu well-organized
tipsBest.s2Body:
• Enable push notifications so you never miss an order
• Accept or reject new orders as soon as possible
• Keep order statuses updated so customers and drivers know what's happening
• Use the search feature to quickly find specific orders
tipsBest.s3Body:
• Create time-limited coupons to drive urgency
• Set minimum order values to increase average order size
• Use coupons during slow periods to boost sales
• Track coupon usage to see which promotions work best
tipsBest.s4Body:
• Check your daily stats on the Home screen regularly
• Review weekly and monthly trends in the Statistics section
• Pay attention to your top-selling items
• Use insights to adjust your menu and pricing strategy
